$comment: Whether one input counts as walking (isWalkingCadence / isWalkingActivity). input is either {cadence} (steps/s) or {activity, confidence}. config overrides the defaults (minCadence 1.5, maxCadence 2.5 inclusive; movingActivities [walking]; minActivityConfidence 0.5, inclusive).

cases.name: cadence at the lower band edge (1.5) is walking
cadence at the upper band edge (2.5) is walking
cadence just below the band (1.49) is not walking
cadence just above the band (2.51) is not walking
cadence in the middle of the band (1.8) is walking
no cadence (0) is not walking
shaking cadence (3.5) is not walking
custom band 1.5-1.7 excludes 1.8
custom band 1.5-1.7 includes 1.7
walking with full confidence is walking
walking at exactly the minimum confidence (0.5) counts
walking just below the minimum confidence (0.49) does not count
iOS low confidence (0.33) does not count
iOS medium confidence (0.67) counts
running is not walking by default
automotive is not walking
cycling is not walking
stationary is not walking
unknown is not walking
running counts when listed in movingActivities
walking does not count when movingActivities is empty
a stricter minimum confidence rejects iOS medium (0.67)
